# dsh-office-live

Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read, screenshot and edit **the document the user
currently

has open** in Word / Excel / PowerPoint — no file round-trips, no "close and
reopen", the change app
ears in the window the user is looking at.

Unlike `dsh-office-tools` (which reads and writes `.docx`/`.xlsx`/`.pptx` files), this plugin
attach

es to the **running Office application** through COM and works on the live document —
including what
ever the user has typed since the file was saved.
## Demo

A live Word window after `office_live_edit` appended two sections and a table — the change is
alread
y on screen, nothing was saved:

Excel: `office_live_read` returned the evaluated formula values, then `excel.set_cell` wrote a
new "
备注" column into the open workbook:
PowerPoint: `ppt.set_text` rewrote the bullet list and `ppt.add_slide` added the second slide:

> How it is built (three layers, the JSON bridge, why results go through a UTF-8 side file,
> why ed
its are not saved by default): **docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md** (in Chinese).
## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
| `office_live_status` | Which of Word / Excel / PowerPoint is running and which documents are open

|
| `office_live_read` | Read live contents as JSON (Word paragraphs + styles, Excel cells with eval

uated formulas, PowerPoint shapes) |
| `office_live_shot` | PNG screenshot of the application window

(ribbon and page) |
| `office_live_snapshot` | `read` + `shot` in one call — best starting point be

fore editing |
| `office_live_edit` | Batch live edits (paragraphs, find/replace, tables, cells, sli

des) |
| `office_live_open` | Open a file in the real application so edits are visible on screen |
|
`office_live_close` | Close the window (optionally saving) |
`office_live_edit` operations:

- Word — `word.append_paragraph`, `word.insert_paragraph_before`, `word.set_paragraph`,
`word.replac

e`, `word.insert_table`, `word.insert_page_break`
- Excel — `excel.set_cell`, `excel.set_range`, `ex

cel.add_sheet`
- PowerPoint — `ppt.set_text`, `ppt.add_slide`
## Requirements

- Windows with a desktop Microsoft Office installation (COM ProgIDs `Word.Application`,
`Excel.Appli

cation`, `PowerPoint.Application`). Tested with Office LTSC 2024.
- Windows PowerShell 5.1+ (`powers

hell.exe`); override with the `OFFICE_LIVE_POWERSHELL`
environment variable (for example `pwsh.exe`)

.
- Maybe counter-intuitive but real Office only. Microsoft Store "Office" stubs and web
versions ex
pose no COM automation; WPS Office uses different ProgIDs.
## Safety

- Attaches to an **already running** instance; it never creates a hidden copy of a document.
- Edits

are **not saved** unless `save: true` is passed, so the user can review the change
in the window, u

ndo it with Ctrl+Z, or ask for more changes first.
- Word reads are capped at the first 400 paragrap

hs; Excel reads the active sheet's used
range up to 200 rows × 40 columns.
- Taking a screenshot bri
ngs the window to the foreground (it steals focus for a moment).

## How it is wired

`lib/index.js` registers the seven tools with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and shells out to
`assets/off

ice-live.ps1`, passing `-ResultFile` (a UTF-8 side file, so Chinese text is not
mangled by the Windo

ws console code page). The script does the COM and screenshot work and
prints one JSON object per ca

prints one JSON object per call.
